nodes.speaker: ada
nodes.text: The pouch was sound when I left it. I spent the whole signal stop sorting the ordinary bags; I never entered the guard's van.

nodes.speaker: arthur
nodes.text: I checked the seal ledger before and after Redbridge. No one should have had the spare key without my knowing.

nodes.speaker: finn
nodes.text: I was on the platform the whole time. The train never gave me a chance to climb aboard after it left Victoria.
